svg.title: Custom clock targets, automatic overclocking and bounded backoff
svg.desc: Lower custom targets use no second voltage sweep. Upward searches use finite rungs and higher-voltage retries within the endpoint.

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Explicit custom target
differs from Auto defaults?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Test lower clocks at the proven voltage
At most 10 steps; stop on ordinary failure or cache
Do not repeat voltage descent

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Any passing measured candidate
inside the custom limits?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Report unmet custom target
Earlier checkpoints remain available

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Build at most 10 unique main rungs
Use editable voltage bins and the MHz ceiling

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Performance: OC toward the endpoint
Full-scan E/B: reclaim clock when power-bound
No table endpoint: retain the passing undervolt

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Legal rung remains
outside failed / consumed bands?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Keep the passing selection
Custom search: apply limits and tier scoring
No eligible custom point → target error

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
At most one bounded fallback attempt
Selected passing MHz at highest legal ladder voltage
Then end the climb

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Retry the same MHz at higher editable voltages
Never above the voltage ceiling
Skip failed and consumed voltage bands
